name: Seared Maple-Dijon Pork Chop with Fennel, Apple & Walnut Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, roughly chop walnuts.
Once the skillet is hot, add walnuts and cook, stirring constantly, until lightly browned, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Place maple syrup, Dijon, salt, and pepper in another small bowl. Whisk to combine the maple-Dijon sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp pure maple syrup
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels, then return to medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, bone-in
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
6 fennel bulbs
3 Granny Smith apples
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a large bowl. Add oil, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulbs. Halve fennel bulbs lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apples. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl, along with cooled walnuts, and gently toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pork chops and salad between plates. Drizzle chops with maple-Dijon sauce. Enjoy!
